Name: Hill of Ammah
Description: A hill facing Giah, by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon, where Joab's pursuit of Abner ended at sunset after Asahel was killed.
BiblicalSignificance: Ammah is where the pursuit after the battle at Gibeon's pool came to a halt, and Abner called for an end to the fighting between brothers.
RelatedPeople: Joab, Son of Zeruiah; Abner, Son of Ner; Asahel, Son of Zeruiah
